text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Feliz! Año! Nuevo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And you know what that means! Let's get going!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I already got the tickets!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsure of what she's talking about, I let El Condor Pasa lead me off.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There it is! Let's gooo! The finishing hold!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, ding, diiing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some reason, we end up watching wrestling together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the match, we decide to walk around a nearby amusement park.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! The heat of that match was incredible. Nothing kicks off the new year quite like wrestling!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: In fact, it doesn't even feel like a new year has started without watching a match!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's like watching a litter of cubs grow into lions. Intense and… filled with heated moments!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That kind of fresh conflict is the real thrill of wrestling! And that's exactly the kind of competition I want!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I wanna compete with Grass for the championship belt someday!
choice_data_list: It has to be Grass Wonder?
It has to be Grass Wonder?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? Well… someone else would be okay too, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I think Grass would make for the most fearsome opponent.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Beneath her calm expression lurks an unbending, unflagging—blazing blue flame that will never burn out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I live with her, so I understand that better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to debuting in the same year as El Condor Pasa, Grass Wonder is also her roommate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And among her many rivals, it seems like El Condor Pasa sees Grass Wonder as her biggest rival.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer, there is a reason I brought you to a wrestling match today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I wanna learn some wrestling techniques this New Year's!
choice_data_list: Do you think that'll be… useful?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It'll be hella useful! My papa is a wrestler and he says the techniques are good for any sport!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, here's where you come in! I want you to pick what move I master!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Throws! I bet throwing a bunch of stuff will help me strengthen my legs and hips!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: First up! Weight tossing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ten kilos? Ha. Twenty? Pshaw. Even thirty kilograms is nothing with my strength!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll throw a dragnet at the beach… facing backwards!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ready, go! Fisher's suplex!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And lastly… Wh-what's that?! A sickeningly sweet parfait challenge?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Barf! I haaate sweet things! This challenge sucks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, she decides to toss the rest of her training. Still, it seems like throwing so many things has made her stronger.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh! Sleeper holds! Submission is hella important!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Break out or tap out! Gimme your best shot, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Urgh… this is… tough. I can't move at all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But don't underestimate me! This is… this is…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… See, I got out! Phew! That was… somethi…ng…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She falls asleep while we train. It's not what we were going for, but it looks like we've managed to lift some of her exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oooh, tag team tactics! It's muy importante that the two of us stay in sync!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's take on a ton of challenges together this New Year's!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: First up, karaoke!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Duets, harmonizing, and cheering!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next up, co-op gaming!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fighting games, rhythm games, and shooters!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do some dancing too! Get your breathing in sync with mine and lift me up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We learn a lot of new movement patterns through various cooperative games.
